headline: CP-Meiji Invests 4.8 Billion Baht in New Dairy Production Facility in Thailand
summary: Dairy producer CP-Meiji announced a 4.8 billion baht investment to build a new factory in Saraburi province to meet growing consumer demand for functional milk products.
why: CP-Meiji is a joint venture between Thailand's CP Group and Japan's Meiji Co, leading commercial dairy production in Thailand.
